name: Sickleprop
description: The weight circles slowly at the user's side on a qi-warmed chain, ready to leap to any angle.

name: Tangknob Flog
description: Qi surges into the chain as the weight whirls overhead and comes down on the target with doubled bite.

name: Sickleblade Flog
description: After three quiet turns the weight is let go at its fastest point and flies straight at the mark.

name: Sicklehurdle
description: The user steps around the opponent along a tightening spiral that keeps the whirling weight between them.

name: Sicklepull Scorer
description: A steady qi feed keeps the weight whirling, and the user lets it strike from whichever angle opens first.

name: Sicklehasp
description: The spinning weight is driven through the path of the opponent's swinging weapon, throwing off its rhythm and line.

name: Regimen Rodhandle
description: Chain held in open loops from palm to elbow, the user stands ready to feed it out in any direction.

name: Ember Tangle
description: The weight is cast at the opponent's forearm so the chain winds around it on its return swing.

name: Splice Lashcut
description: The chain is flicked in a spiral around an opponent's weapon haft and tightened with a short pull.

name: Emberkusari
description: Chain pays out through the hand during a cut, adding a hand's length to the kama's reach.

name: Haze Chainkey
description: When an opponent grabs the chain, a sharp tug in the opposite direction wrenches it from their hand.

name: Discord Snare
description: A twist of the wrist frees a snagged chain and snaps the weight against the hand that caught it.

name: Tanglescreen
description: The chain winds three times around a spear or staff and a firm pull locks it against the user's body.

name: Weightball Prop
description: Chain wrapped about the opponent's legs is hauled hard with a stepping turn, dropping them to the earth.

name: Chainloop Barrier
description: With the kama thrust forward and the weight trailing behind the hip, the user shows only the blade.

name: Stern Entwine
description: The blade is drawn straight back toward the user's own chest, cutting whatever it has hooked.

name: Raw Weightswing
description: The trailing weight is flung forward from behind the hip while the blade hand holds the opponent's eyes.

name: Ballbind Screen
description: The chain is pulled taut across the body to stop a cut from the weak side.

name: Scudding Chainlength
description: Short sliding steps take the user from the weight's range to the blade's range without a gap.

name: Vicious Chainloop
description: A thrown weight forces the guard up, and the kama then cuts into the exposed side in one linked motion.

name: Clutching Pommelring
description: Fighting close with the blade, the user suddenly feeds out the chain and strikes from a range the opponent has not measured.

name: Buttressed Chainlength
description: The user turns the blade shoulder forward and keeps the chain hand tucked back, covering the armed side.

name: Brasssnare
description: A quick tap of the hooked tip against the opponent's forearm numbs the hand that holds the weapon.

name: Kusariswat
description: The weight is thrown in a short line at the elbow of the opponent's sword arm.

name: Stamp Ballbind
description: The hooked tip catches the opponent's sleeve cuff and holds the hand away from its target.

name: Rill Snare
description: Rolling the lead shoulder inward, the user lets a thrust slide past and steps in under it.

name: Humkama
description: The blade and haft close like a pair of tongs on the opponent's blade and press it aside.

name: Weighty Entwine
description: Chain wound around the opponent's weapon arm is held under qi tension so the arm cannot cut or pull free.

name: Static Pommelring
description: A hooked wrist is twisted and hauled downward so the opponent's weapon points at the ground.

name: Rugged Sicklehook
description: Weight and blade arrive at the pinned arm from opposite sides in the same breath and crush it between them.

name: Tangknob Buckle
description: The user stands with the weight slowly turning in a ring at arm's length and the kama held ready.

name: Kusariscorer
description: The turning ring is steered into a straight line and the weight strikes the opponent's guard like a thrown wheel.

name: Sicklescorer
description: The ring is broken by a sudden release and the weight flies off tangent to the opponent's face.

name: Tangleglide
description: The user walks backward on the heel while the ring keeps spinning in front to cover the retreat.

name: Stalwart Rodhandle
description: A large qi-fed ring of spinning chain stands between user and opponent and bats aside arrows, darts and blades alike.

name: Kamabuckle
description: At the instant a blow is turned, the ring opens and the weight shoots at the attacker like a shot.

name: Shielding Weightball
description: Chain paid out to full length and the weight held low, the user keeps the opponent at the edge of reach.

name: Stern Sicklehook
description: Chain half paid out, the kama is flicked forward to rake the opponent from a pace beyond arm's length.

name: Sleetkusari
description: The weight is jabbed straight out like a spear tip at the opponent's throat and pulled back at once.

name: Rilltangle
description: The hand slides up the chain as the user steps forward, shortening the reach as the gap shrinks.

name: Draught Tangknob
description: The weight swings out sideways to slap a thrusting weapon off line before it enters the user's reach.

name: Clay Lashcut
description: A short hop behind a thrown weight lands the user within blade distance as the guard drops.

name: Hungry Sicklepull
description: With the chain at its full length the point of the kama just nicks the opponent's lead hand.

name: Hazesnare
description: The user shows the long cast and then shortens the chain, so the opponent's counter lands on empty air.

name: Weighty Weightswing
description: The weight is laid across the opponent's lead foot and held there under qi pressure to fix them in place.

name: Bold Tangle
description: The hook bites, the chain pulls, and the user rides the pull straight into a cut at close range.

name: Stalwart Chainkey
description: Sunk low with the kama's hook forward, the user waits to catch the first limb that comes close.

name: Kusariflog
description: The hook sets behind the calf and is dragged through it as the user steps backward.

name: Hungry Tangle
description: A short flick of the chain taps the weight against the opponent's brow and blinds one eye with blood or dust.

name: Kamaprop
description: The blade tip catches the opponent's belt and holds on while the user pulls the opponent forward.

name: Fleet Chainkey
description: Turning away on one foot, the user drags the hooked opponent along the same curve and unbalances them.

name: Gripping Weightswing
description: One hook catches the opponent's leg, one pull lifts it, and a sweeping cut finishes before the foot comes down.

name: Cramping Sicklehook
description: The hook stays set in the opponent's clothing while the user backs away, hauling them stumbling after.

name: Pommelring Prop
description: Kama and chain are held evenly to the front and the weight is kept low, so either hand can act at once.

name: Crimson Snare
description: Inside arm's reach the hook is punched forward and pulled sharply across the opponent's flank.

name: Hum Chainlength
description: Standing beyond blade range, the user whirls once and sends the weight at the opponent's midsection.

name: Kamacordial
description: A light touch of the weight on the ground or the opponent's shin tells the user the exact distance between them.

name: Draught Weightball
description: The heavy end of the chain is dropped in the path of an incoming cut and takes the blow.

name: Springing Rodhandle
description: Rear foot and front foot trade places in a smooth glide that shifts the user from far range to near.

name: Bold Lashcut
description: A far cast, a pull-in and a close hook cut are run together so the opponent never settles on a range.

name: Ballbind Prop
description: The chain lashes around the opponent's body at far range and the pull carries them into the waiting blade.
